posts.title: Fear and Photography
posts.description: I’m part of a creative group who meet weekly to talk about our endeavours. This week we talked about fear prompted by Week 9 of The Artist’s Way by Julia Cameron. For me, fear tends to come from one of two places: internal or external. So Internal fear: I’ve been fortunate enough to have had my work recognised by some awards. posts.title: Commission with WCPP
posts.description: I was honoured to recently collaborate with the Wales Centre for Public Policy to make a series of photographs with people who have experienced poverty in a stigma-free way. The commission took place in Swansea and the surrounding area, with people whose lives and experiences deserve to be represented with dignity.
